name: workforce-model-bridge
description: A request-centered V-model workspace with autonomous engineering agents, verified products and 9router controls.

languageModelTools.name: workforce_request
languageModelTools.userDescription: Submit a request to WorkForce, inspect its progress, or answer a question and continue.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Submit the user's ordinary requirement to the exact open workspace. WorkForce owns planning, agent sessions, implementation, independent review/testing and recovery. Return the saved receipt; do not implement the accepted request separately. Use status or pause/resume/cancel with its returned workflow_id. Include answer on resume only for a pending genuine user question. Retrying submit recovers its saved identity; submit_new explicitly creates another request after the previous receipt was acknowledged. Never invent identifiers or credentials. The user request and project policy define the authorized scope.

workspace_folder.description: Exact absolute local workspace folder for this request. Required to avoid mixing projects in multi-root windows.

requirement.description: The user's requested outcome and constraints. Use for submit or an intentional submit_new; retries of submit retain the saved intake identity.

workflow_id.description: An existing workflow ID returned by WorkForce. Required for pause, resume and cancel; optional for status.

title.description: Optional short title for a new submit.

answer.description: The user answer to the selected request pending question; use with resume.

question_id.description: Exact pending question ID returned by WorkForce status. Required with answer; never invent or replace it.

workforce.bridge.runtimePath.description: Absolute path to a trusted WorkForce package directory containing package.json and built dist. Read only from User settings.
